title: 7 Day Kenya and Tanzania Safari: Amboseli, Tarangire and Ngorongoro
rank_math_title: Kenya Tanzania Safari 7 Days: Amboseli to Ngorongoro
rank_math_desc: Kenya Tanzania safari for 7 days: Amboseli under Kilimanjaro, cross at Namanga to Tarangire, Lake Manyara and Ngorongoro Crater, ending in Arusha.
post_content: This Kenya Tanzania safari fits two countries into one week by crossing at the Namanga border.
overview:
This Kenya Tanzania safari fits two countries into one week by crossing at the Namanga border. Start with two nights in Amboseli for elephants against the backdrop of Kilimanjaro, then continue to Tarangire, Lake Manyara and Ngorongoro Crater, finishing in Arusha. It is a practical route for travellers with limited time who want Kenya's elephants and Tanzania's crater in one trip.

Price: from USD 2,540 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Two nights in Amboseli with views of Kilimanjaro
Tarangire and Lake Manyara game drives

faq.q: How much does this Kenya Tanzania safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 2,540 per adult sharing, based on low-season rates. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.
Namanga is the main border between Nairobi and Arusha and the quickest link between Amboseli and Tanzania's northern parks.

faq.q: Can we end in Nairobi instead?
faq.a: Yes. A shuttle or short flight links Arusha with Nairobi.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Drive from Nairobi to Amboseli National Park. Afternoon game drive. Dinner and overnight at Amboseli Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives among the elephant herds and swamps below Kilimanjaro. Dinner and overnight at Amboseli Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Amboseli to Tarangire
itinerary.content: Drive to the Namanga border, meet your Tanzanian guide and continue to Tarangire. Dinner and overnight at Tarangire Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Tarangire to Lake Manyara
itinerary.content: Morning game drive in Tarangire, then an afternoon game drive at Lake Manyara. Dinner and overnight at Kitela Lodge in Karatu.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.content: Descend into the crater for a game drive. Dinner and overnight at Kitela Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha
itinerary.content: Morning visit to a coffee farm or local market in Karatu, then drive to Arusha. Overnight at Mount Meru Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure from Arusha
itinerary.content: Transfer to Kilimanjaro airport or take the shuttle back to Nairobi.

Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
